mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_approval (id, type, session_id, order_id, amount, reason, created_at_ms, status, operator, decision_note, decided_at_ms, execution_status, execution_failure_reason, execution_attempts) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{sessionId}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{createdAtMs}, #{status}, #{operator}, #{decisionNote}, #{decidedAtMs}, #{executionStatus}, #{executionFailureReason}, #{executionAttempts}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), operator = VALUES(operator), decision_note = VALUES(decision_note), decided_at_ms = VALUES(decided_at_ms), execution_status = VALUES(execution_status), execution_failure_reason = VALUES(execution_failure_reason), execution_attempts = VALUES(execution_attempts)
